'''Iltarr City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]], and the location of the [[Marblewood Estate]], the home of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun sector chief|Sector Chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]]. It was [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|policed]] by the [[Iltarr City police]]. [[Rachele Ree]] was a member of the [[Wukkar aristocracy]] who was very familiar with the city and its citizens. Iltarr City was said to have the best [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] food on the planet.
